page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m1.large is an entry-level compute instance based on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 architecture. The server is provisioned with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core across 2 threads using an Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. Cache sizing consists of 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 33 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity is set at 2.0 GB of RAM, representing a 1:1 vCPU-to-memory allocation (1.0 GB per core). Local disk storage is not bundled, requiring external network block storage. No GPU acceleration is present, and baseline network throughput is rated at 1 Gbps.

Benchmark measurements highlight the constraints of this small-footprint hardware setup. The processor delivers a stress-ng single-core score of 1099.89 and a multi-core score of 1457.99, aligning with the lowest performance tiers. PassMark CPU testing yields an overall score of 1819.5, with extended instructions reaching 1398.29 and encryption performance registering 672.63. Memory throughput reflects similar constraints: small cached block reads clock at 81.68 GB/sec, while uncached 256 MB reads and writes measure 9.96 GB/sec and 9.32 GB/sec, respectively.

Application-level tests indicate suitable performance for light, low-concurrency tasks. Redis operations achieve 1.48 million SET operations per second, while static web serving throughput measures 1.3 GB/sec. Data processing tests show gzip single-threaded compression at 18.98 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 7.37 GB/sec. Inference with a small 135M model yields 124.22 tokens per second for prompt processing and 35.53 tokens per second for text generation, though the 2.0 GB memory envelope prevents execution of standard 7B or 70B parameter models.

Given the modest hardware profile and absence of local storage, ecs.u0.c1m1.large is tailored for lightweight workloads where compute and memory demands are minimal. It fits background monitoring agents, low-traffic web hooks, lightweight proxies, and low-scale dev/test environments that operate within constrained resource footprints.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m1.large is an entry-tier x86_64 virtual instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It provides 2 vCPUs from a single physical core with hyper-threading enabled, accompanied by 2.0 GB of system memory (1.0 GB per vCPU). The instance includes no onboard local storage, relying entirely on network-attached volumes, and features a baseline network throughput of 1 Gbps with no GPU accelerators. In synthetic and application benchmarks, performance ranks in the lower tiers, achieving 1819.5 on the PassMark CPU test, 1.48 million Redis SET operations per second, and 1.3 GB/sec for static web delivery. With its 1:1 CPU-to-memory ratio and restricted resource bounds, this instance is suited for lightweight utility tasks, small development and test nodes, microservices, and low-traffic API endpoints.
